scope: CPU-only independent review of seven named analysis artifacts; no renderer source edits, builds, GPU queries, or renderer launches.
current_acceptance: No final acceptance: formal manifest has all four evidence flags false and all timing capture-disabled declarations false; two Corona PT halves remain required according to assignment context.
verified_correct: Manifest conventions: original fresh_pt_sum SUM /1024; RTXPT gi-mean and RTXDI capture.mean MEAN /1; Corona reference.pfm MEAN /1. Original validity comes from normal alpha, not derivativeDepth in position alpha.
PFM reader validates little-endian unit-scale RGB and flips bottom-up rows to top-left; existing analytic test passed.
Corona guide canonicalization multiplies position and normal XYZ by [1,1,-1], without image flipping; existing analytic test passed.

Temporal mean/M2 are computed per repeat; pooled M2 sums within-repeat deviations. Targeted three-by-32 test gave 96 frames, 93 temporal degrees of freedom, 93 lag pairs, and standard deviation 9.38083151964686, exactly matching analytic expected value. Repeat mean offsets did not inflate pooled temporal noise.
Per-frame L2 NRMSE uses pooled per-frame luminance MSE divided by common-reference luminance power. Time-mean error and signed relative brightness bias are separately reported.

Each reference mean is (A+B)/2; its estimated noise MSE is (A-B)^2/4. Cross-reference MSE and its independent split expectation, centered half-difference Pearson correlation, and tile residuals use the intended formulas.

Per-frame native stage sums precede percentile/median summaries; original validation work and repeated spatial rows are included when present; Corona CPU render wall time is not mislabeled whole GPU time.

findings.title: Final status does not require all producers or quality results
findings.evidence: A CPU synthetic manifest with all four review flags true, guides={}, a single two-half producer, and quality={} returned status=quality_complete with an empty quality object.
findings.impact: An accidentally reused partial progressive manifest can produce a final-looking status before four producers/eight halves or four renderer quality results exist.
findings.recommendation: Before non-diagnostics final quality, require exact producer sets original/rtxpt/rtxdi/corona_pt, guide and quality sets original/rtxpt/rtxdi/corona_port, and expected two1024-spp halves; retain partial diagnostics as explicitly partial.

findings.title: Timing provenance is a manifest declaration rather than runtime proof
findings.evidence: main checks raw_capture_disabled is True but never loads repeat.evidence or enforces unique process run/CSV identities. Reusing one CSV for all three entries is permitted.
findings.impact: The output can claim three process runs and no-capture timing from one run or capture-enabled runs.
findings.recommendation: Validate completed runtime/launch records and actual capture-off settings, process completion and freeze identity; require unique executed run identities and bind CSV hashes. Preserve a blocked status when runtime evidence is absent.

findings.title: Exact timing window and native dispatch invariants are underchecked
findings.evidence: Formal main accepts arbitrary warmup/measured. analyze_repeat requires only measured-frame subset and stage presence. CPU original fixture with one restirSpatialCS row passed despite the required two. RTXPT fixture with GI4ms+prep2ms and fullGPU5ms passed. A wholly missing supplied fullGPU window is treated as unavailable.
findings.impact: Missing or duplicated native stages, incomplete startup coverage, wrong windows or misaligned whole-frame timestamps can silently bias timing.
findings.recommendation: Enforce120 warmup/240 measured in formal main, native frame coverage and required per-frame stage multiplicities, wholeGPU>=GI+prep, and full coverage for known native full-frame scopes. Keep custom helper counts for analytic tests. Corona candidate-batch ordinal mapping also needs proof against renderer-frame/QPC metadata; legitimate combine-only batches must remain excluded.

findings.title: Declared storage/sample normalization is never cross-validated
findings.evidence: A reference half declared storage=SUM,spp=1024,divisor=1 is accepted. completed_run checks renderer frame counts but trusts manifest spp/storage/divisor when normalizing. The current formal manifest values are correct.
findings.impact: A mistyped executed manifest silently changes radiometric scale while retaining a validated/completed label.
findings.recommendation: Require producer-specific SUM/MEAN format, spp1024, divisor1024 for original and divisor1 for the three mean producers; enforce the declared half offset pair and bind each raw path to its validated producer run.

limitations_not_bugs: One independent split is a noisy variance estimator; clipped noise-adjusted MSE is diagnostic. Shared systematic transport errors or correlated producer streams can pass mean comparisons. Existing README/policy acknowledge this correctly.

The policy JSON thresholds currently match reviewer hard-coded screens, but the reviewer does not load/hash the policy. Future policy edits would not alter screens; consider binding the predeclared policy hash.

Completed external runs wait for final launch provenance before admission, which avoids the known completion-marker-before-process-finalization race. Raw/provenance files are then reread and outputs are written without atomic snapshot publication, so review assumes completed-run artifacts remain immutable and consumers do not parse an output mid-write.

review_reference_progress.py uses Python assert for27 audit checks. The documented python -B invocation preserves them; running with python -O would disable them. Explicit validation exceptions are more robust if optimized execution must be supported.

A wholly empty guide-consistent diagnostic mask can produce NaN diagnostics in the progressive reviewer, unlike analyze_multibounce.main which adds that region only when nonempty. This is an availability issue, not a false pass.

verification.result: Confirmed R1,R3,R4 as described. All temporary fixtures created under .workspace/tmp/rtxgi-multibounce-independent-review and removed by TemporaryDirectory.

changes_made: Only this independent review JSON was written. No owned analysis scripts or renderer artifacts were mutated.

rereview_v2.supersedes_initial_findings: R1 fixed by exact final renderer/reference sets, offsets and common inclusion. R4 storage/spp/divisor fixed; owner is separately adding strict sourcefile-in-run binding. R2/R3 substantially improved by actual process/no-capture/binary checks, exact360 coverage, native counted stages and authoritative Corona QPC event mapping.

remaining_findings.title: Known native whole-frame GPU ranges may be absent or duplicated
remaining_findings.evidence: CPU RTXPT fixture with all required GI/prep scopes and no Frame.RenderGPU row was accepted with full_GPU_frame=null. Adding two identical8ms Frame.RenderGPU rows was accepted as one16ms full-frame range. Original formal main likewise permits omitted full_gpu_csv.
remaining_findings.impact: Only Corona should lack a genuine full GPU range. Missing known ranges silently remove the required measurement; duplicated timestamps inflate it.
remaining_findings.recommendation: Require exactly one native full-GPU event per measured RTXPT/RTXDI frame. Require original canonical gpu-frames.csv from the same validated run, hash it as evidence, and require exact frame coverage. Preserve unavailable full-GPU only for Corona.

remaining_findings.title: Frozen descriptor is compared but actual executed transport fields are not
remaining_findings.evidence: A CPU original-run fixture with launch frozen transport5/16/1, successful360frame process, actual benchmark-config min_depth2/max_depth2/RR_threshold9 and CLI depth2 was accepted by validate_timing_provenance as no_capture_actual=true.
remaining_findings.impact: A wrong CLI/runtime transport can produce timing for a cheaper/different workload while retaining the intended attached physical descriptor. Reference completed_run already validates these actual fields.
remaining_findings.recommendation: Apply actual runtime depth/RR checks to timing: original benchmark-config, RTXPT actual-settings, RTXDI capture.settings.GI and Corona contract.settings; keep each renderer native reuse work unchanged.
